title: Differential Calculus: Gradients and Equations of Tangents
seo_title: Grade 12 Equations of Tangents Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Find equations of tangents to graphs of functions.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 12 calculus worksheets: gradients of tangents, equations of tangents and tangents parallel to a line. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • The gradient of the tangent at x = a is f′(a).
  • Find the point too: y = f(a).
  • Equation of the tangent: y − y₁ = m(x − x₁).
  • A tangent parallel to y = mx + c has gradient m: solve f′(x) = m.

Examples

Example

f(x) = x² − 3x at x = 2

f(2) = −2, f′(2) = 1

Answer: y = x − 4

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
f or f′The gradient is f′(a).
The pointUse (a; f(a)).
Missing ySubstitute back to find y.

Find the equation of the tangent to f(x) = 3x² + 4x + 6 that is parallel to the line y = −2x − 3.
items.e: Parallel: f′(x) = −2, so 6x + 4 = −2 and x = −1. The point is (−1; 5): y = −2x + 3.

items.q: Find the equation of the tangent to f(x) = −2x² + 4x − 5 that is parallel to the line y = −4x + 5.
items.e: Parallel: f′(x) = −4, so −4x + 4 = −4 and x = 2. The point is (2; −5): y = −4x + 3.

items.q: Find the equation of the tangent to f(x) = −x² − 2x − 2 that is parallel to the line y = −6x + 5.
items.e: Parallel: f′(x) = −6, so −2x − 2 = −6 and x = 2. The point is (2; −10): y = −6x + 2.

items.q: Find the equation of the tangent to f(x) = −x² − 2x + 4 that is parallel to the line y = 2x − 3.
items.e: Parallel: f′(x) = 2, so −2x − 2 = 2 and x = −2. The point is (−2; 4): y = 2x + 8.

items.e: Parallel: f′(x) = 0, so 2x − 2 = 0 and x = 1. The point is (1; −4): y = −4.
